# Bridgewater Roofer

> Bridgewater Roofer is a licensed and fully insured residential and commercial roofing contractor headquartered at 400 Commons Way, Bridgewater, NJ 08807. Serving homeowners and commercial property managers across Somerset County, New Jersey, the company specializes in steep-slope architectural shingle installations, standing seam metal roofs, low-slope flat roofs (TPO/EPDM), precision leak diagnostics, storm damage restoration, and 24/7 emergency dispatch. NJ Home Improvement Contractor License #13VH09876500. Direct phone: (908) 465-9944.

## Core Roofing Services

- [Roof Repair](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/roof-repair-bridgewater-nj/): Targeted shingle replacement, ridge cap fixes, flashing recaulking, chimney counterflashing, and pipe boot leak isolation.
- [Roof Replacement](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/roof-replacement-bridgewater-nj/): Complete tear-off to bare wood decking, rotting plywood replacement, ice & water shield installation, and 50-year non-prorated architectural shingle systems.
- [Roof Leak Repair](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/roof-leak-repair-bridgewater-nj/): Diagnostic moisture tracing, infrared scanning, interior ceiling water containment, and permanent structural waterproofing.
- [Emergency Roof Repair](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/emergency-roof-repair-bridgewater-nj/): 24/7 on-call dispatch for sudden tree limb punctures, severe roof punctures, blow-offs, and emergency protective poly-tarping.
- [Storm Damage Roof Repair](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/storm-damage-roof-repair-bridgewater-nj/): Wind crease inspection, hail impact assessments, comprehensive photographic damage documentation, and insurance scope assistance.
- [Residential Roofing](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/residential-roofing-bridgewater-nj/): Steep-slope roofing solutions tailored for New Jersey single-family homes, colonials, ranches, and estates.
- [Commercial Roofing](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/commercial-roofing-bridgewater-nj/): Low-slope commercial installations, single-ply membrane systems, roof drains, coping caps, and preventative facility maintenance.
- [Roof Inspection](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/roof-inspection-bridgewater-nj/): 21-point certified structural inspection covering decking integrity, flashings, attic ventilation, gutters, and remaining shingle lifespan.
- [Metal Roofing](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/metal-roofing-bridgewater-nj/): Premium concealed-fastener standing seam metal roof systems designed for 50+ year longevity, wind resistance up to 140 MPH, and high thermal reflectivity.
- [Flat Roofing](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/flat-roofing-bridgewater-nj/): TPO (thermoplastic polyolefin), EPDM (synthetic rubber), and modified bitumen solutions engineered for flat roof sections, porches, and commercial structures.
- [Roofing Services Hub](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/roofing-services/): Complete index of all residential, commercial, and emergency roofing capabilities.

## Somerset County Service Areas

Bridgewater Roofer provides localized dispatch, rapid on-site quotes, and municipal permit handling across all primary Somerset County municipalities:

- [Bridgewater, NJ](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/): Primary service hub and headquarters covering Green Knoll, Finderne, Bradley Gardens, and Sunset Lake.
- [Somerville, NJ](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/service-area/roofer-somerville-nj/): Flashing maintenance and steep-slope shingle systems for historic Victorian, craftsman, and colonial residences.
- [Raritan, NJ](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/service-area/roofer-raritan-nj/): Neighborhood re-roofing, chimney step flashing, and gutter-to-drip-edge integration for residential properties.
- [Martinsville, NJ](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/service-area/roofer-martinsville-nj/): High-elevation roofing suited for Watchung Mountain wind exposure, heavy tree canopy shade, and moss prevention.
- [Bound Brook, NJ](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/service-area/roofer-bound-brook-nj/): Water runoff engineering, heavy storm drainage, and ice dam prevention in the Raritan River valley.
- [Hillsborough, NJ](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/service-area/roofer-hillsborough-nj/): Complete roof replacements and ventilation upgrades for large suburban developments and multi-acre estates.
- [Warren, NJ](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/service-area/roofer-warren-nj/): Custom estate roofing, premium designer shingles, standing seam copper accents, and high-wind ridge cap reinforcement.
- [Basking Ridge, NJ](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/service-area/roofer-basking-ridge-nj/): Bernards Township code-compliant roofing, historic preservation guidelines, and cedar shake conversions.
- [Branchburg, NJ](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/service-area/roofer-branchburg-nj/): Agricultural, suburban, and commercial roof repairs, metal building installations, and custom residences.
- [Bedminster, NJ](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/service-area/roofer-bedminster-nj/): Luxury equestrian facilities, estate reroofing, copper valley flashing, and architectural roof engineering.
- [Manville, NJ](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/service-area/roofer-manville-nj/): High-durability asphalt shingle replacements, ice barrier installations, and fast emergency leak repairs.
- [Regional Service Area Hub](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/service-area/): Comprehensive overview of towns, travel radius, and municipal building department contacts.

## Materials & Technical Specifications

- [Roofing Materials Guide](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/roofing-materials/): Complete architectural overview of roofing products installed by Bridgewater Roofer.
- **Architectural Asphalt Shingles**: Dual-layer fiberglass laminate shingles (GAF Timberline HDZ, CertainTeed Landmark) with Class A fire ratings and 110–130 MPH wind warranties.
- **Standing Seam Metal**: 24- or 26-gauge Galvalume steel and aluminum with Kynar 500 / Hylar 5000 PVDF finishes. Concealed clip fasteners eliminate through-fastener leak vectors.
- **TPO Single-Ply Membrane**: 60-mil white reflective membrane with hot-air welded seams delivering superior puncture and UV resistance for low-slope applications.
- **EPDM Synthetic Rubber**: 45-mil and 60-mil vulcanized black rubber membranes offering high elasticity across extreme New Jersey freeze-thaw cycles.
- **Ice & Water Shield Underlayment**: Self-adhering modified bitumen membrane installed along all eaves (minimum 24 inches past the interior heated wall line), valleys, and roof penetrations per NJ UCC requirements.

## Pricing & Estimating Resources

- [Roofing Cost Guide & Estimator](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/roofing-cost/): Detailed cost breakdown for New Jersey roof installations, square footage benchmarks, and factor matrices (pitch, tear-off layers, accessibility).
- **Typical NJ Roof Replacement Range**: $8,500 – $22,000+ for standard single-family homes (2,000 – 3,200 sq ft roof area).
- **Typical Minor Roof Repair Range**: $350 – $1,200 (pipe boot replacements, loose ridge caps, flashing reseals).
- **Typical Emergency Tarping Service**: $450 – $950 depending on roof pitch, damage severity, and weather conditions.

## Educational Guides & Technical Knowledge Base

- [Roof Repair vs Replacement Guide](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/blog/roof-repair-vs-replacement/): Actionable criteria for determining when an isolated repair is economically viable versus when total replacement is necessary.
- [What Causes Roof Leaks](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/blog/what-causes-roof-leaks/): Deep dive into the 7 most common roof failure points: dried pipe collars, rusted valley flashing, compromised step flashing, cracked vent stacks, and nail pops.
- [Roof Replacement Cost in Bridgewater, NJ](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/blog/roof-replacement-cost-bridgewater-nj/): Comprehensive local pricing guide reflecting Somerset County labor rates, municipal permit costs, and material tiers.
- [Bridgewater Roofing Permit Guide](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/blog/bridgewater-roofing-permit-guide/): Step-by-step walkthrough of filing UCC construction permits with the Bridgewater Township Code Enforcement office at 100 Commons Way.
- [Asphalt Shingles vs Metal Roofing](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/blog/asphalt-shingles-vs-metal-roofing/): Side-by-side technical evaluation comparing upfront acquisition costs, maintenance requirements, storm durability, and long-term return on investment.
- [What to Check After a NJ Storm](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/blog/what-to-check-after-a-nj-storm/): Essential homeowner safety checklist for safely assessing wind, hail, and tree damage from the ground and inside the attic.
- [How Long Does a Roof Last in New Jersey](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/blog/how-long-does-a-roof-last-in-nj/): Analysis of local climatic factors (humidity, Nor'easters, freeze-thaw cycles) and realistic material lifespans.
- [TPO vs EPDM Commercial Roofing](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/blog/tpo-vs-epdm-roofing/): Technical comparison of single-ply membrane roofing systems for commercial and residential flat roof surfaces.
- [Resources & Blog Hub](https://bridgewaterroofer.com/blog/): Central catalog of all roofing technical publications and homeowner maintenance guides.
